primary_business_description.value: Item 1. Business Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. AMD designs high-performance CPUs, GPUs, and adaptive computing products as a fabless semiconductor company using external foundries. Principal operations: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.. Reported segments include: Data Center (46% of revenue); Client (28% of revenue); Gaming (16% of revenue); Embe
